dialogue_text: Morgan. This boat is mine now. Get off. Giles Barrett! Are you even human? We agreed on fifty-fifty.
We agreed on fifty-fifty. I put in $120,000! Now that we're making money, you use a fake contract to kick me out? You say it's fake, got any proof? Your fingerprint is on it. Even if you go to God,

Even if you go to God, this boat is still mine. For the past year, I found all the fishing spots! Without me, you wouldn't even know where to sail! I kept you around because you were useful. Now I know the routes,

Now I know the routes, why share the cash? Morgan, blame yourself for being dumb. Why would you ever trust me? Fine, I'll remember this. The way you kicked me off the boat today, sooner or later, I'll make you give the boat back.
give the boat back. Worry about how you'll feed yourself. Without the SeaRunner, you are nothing. Set sail!
Take it! Take it all! Stay away! Ding! First feeding successful.

Ding! First feeding successful. BeastBond Protocol activated. Saltwater Crocs live in estuaries, mangroves, and shallow coastal waters. Once bonded, you can communicate, and its strength, speed, endurance, and adaptability will increase.
endurance, and adaptability will increase. Initiate bonding? Beast bonding? It ate all the fish anyway. Bond! Saltwater Croc successfully bonded. This two-legged beast is so generous!
This two-legged beast is so generous! He gave Finn all his food! Just a bit too little, I'm still hungry. My whole day's pay went right into your belly. And you're complaining?

And you're complaining? Since you gave me all your food, you're my boss from now on. Boss, there's a good spot ahead. It's full of things with big claws and long whiskers! Hop on, Boss! I'll take you to catch them. You can carry me out to sea?
You can carry me out to sea? Of course! I'm full of energy right now. As long as you hold on tight, Boss, I'll definitely get you there safe and sound!
This croc is so fierce!
This croc is so fierce! Faster than a fishing boat! This is awesome! Faster, Finn!
Creamback Crabs! And Royal Lobsters! The entrance is full of hidden reefs. Normal boats can't even get in.

Normal boats can't even get in. This is an absolute treasure trove! This is Finn's turf. These guys used to always fight me for space. Now that you're here, Boss, catch as many as you want. I'll drive them out for you! Just one Creamback Crab
Just one Creamback Crab can sell for $100! And Royal Lobsters this big are worth even more! Finn, we're gonna be rich! A Creamback Crab over a pound. Quality like this, can sell for a hundred bucks.
can sell for a hundred bucks. How many do you need, boss? I'll flush them all out for you. Today we're gonna get these two buckets full.
Boss! This one came right to us. Alright. That counts as your catch. You dare pinch Finn? You're getting sold soon
You're getting sold soon to make my boss some cash. This hole goes straight through. Go around and splash gently. I'll catch them here. Watch this, boss!
At least three pounds each. Just these two can sell for two grand. You're amazing, boss! I only splashed twice, and you caught them all! You helped too.
You helped too. Keep looking. Fill it up and I'll buy you fish. Boss! There's another nest here!
This batch of goods can sell for at least four grand. Mom and Dad's shop can finally stay afloat. Giles Barrett You stole my boat, thinking you'd ruined me.
thinking you'd ruined me. But now with Finn, I can still go out to sea and make money! Get on, boss! I'll take you and the catch back!
A croc's in the harbor! And Morgan's riding it! Wait for me in the water. I'll buy you fish when I'm done. Okay! Just call for me, boss, and I'll come right over.
and I'll come right over. Morgan! Why are you riding a croc back here? You told me to find my own way back. Walking was too slow, so I found a ride. Holy crap. This is unbelievable.
This is unbelievable. Look at this massive Royal Lobster! This catch was found right near the SeaRunner. It belongs to the ship. When you kicked me off,

When you kicked me off, all you threw at me were a few trash fish. Now you see good stuff, you suddenly want to call me your deckhand again? Anyone who buys his catch, don't even think about getting fish from the SeaRunner!
If they won't buy it, I will. Bring the scale.
42 pounds of Creamback Crabs. Two lobsters, 6.7 pounds. Plus the conches, that's $5,980 in total. Morgan was kicked off the boat just half a day ago,

Morgan was kicked off the boat just half a day ago, and he rode a croc and made nearly a thousand dollars! Maris Dalton! If you buy his catch, the SeaRunner will never supply you again. Your trash fish I can get anywhere. But live lobsters like this are hard to come by. If you don't supply me,

If you don't supply me, it saves me from picking through your garbage. Bring your good stuff directly to me from now on. I'll pay based on quality. Thanks, Ms. Dalton. Morgan! What happened to your forehead?

What happened to your forehead? Let mom take a look. Mom, it's just a scratch. I'm fine. Giles took the boat and left me on Crab Isle. Luckily, I found another way back. They said you rode a crocodile back.
a crocodile back. Is that true? We saw it ourselves! That croc carried Morgan and two buckets of catch safely to the dock. Morgan told it to go back, and it just swam off.

and it just swam off. Mom, That's a saltwater crocodile. They can live in estuaries and coastal waters. I fed it a few fish when I was on the island. It got used to my scent and is willing to listen to me. Don't worry.
Don't worry. I won't play around with my life. As long as you're safe. My son is very capable. Even without the SeaRunner, you can still make money from the sea. But wild things are wild after all.

are wild after all. If you ride it out to sea again, don't be careless. Dad, I'll remember that. If I'm not sure, I won't risk it. Giles Barrett. When we were partners, you came to my house every day. Calling me "Uncle" all the time.

Calling me "Uncle" all the time. Now that the boat is making money, you kicked my son off. Have you no conscience? Uncle, that was before. Now the boat is mine. Morgan has nothing to do with me anymore. By the way, he was short of 30,000 dollars for his share.

By the way, he was short of 30,000 dollars for his share. You borrowed it from me, using the seafood shop as collateral. If you can't pay it back in ten days, the shop and the back room are mine too. You already took 120,000 dollars from Morgan, and now you're squeezing us for 30,000?

You're pushing us too far! The boat is one thing, the debt is another. The fingerprint on this IOU wasn't put there by me. I'll pay back the 30,000 dollars in ten days. As for the boat and the 120,000 dollars,

As for the boat and the 120,000 dollars, we'll settle that score later. When the time comes, take the money and get out of our shop! Hmph. Got lucky once riding a crocodile, and now you think you're the king of the sea? I'll be waiting.
Tell me if it hurts. Stop acting tough in front of me. It really doesn't. You guys eat too. Stop saving the best for me.
You've been out at sea all day. You need to eat up. Listen to your mom. If you don't eat, she'll grab that bowl and chase you down the street. Hahaha.
Dad. Mom, let's fix the freezer first, and buy some food. We're opening the shop tomorrow. We can manage. Keep this for nets and buckets.

Keep this for nets and buckets. You need some starting capital. Mom, to help me get that boat you spent all your savings and mortgaged the shop. Now that the boat's gone, I can't let you shoulder this.
I can't let you shoulder this. I know you'll earn it all back, but you matter more than the shop. Don't risk your life out at sea. I know what I'm doing. This family you've protected it for years.

you've protected it for years. Now it's my turn. City Grill needs them by tomorrow night. They want a batch of large Abalone. Big enough. Alive and uninjured. You can make at least $10,000 on this order.
Why ask me first? Others can't reach the deep reef. You can ride a crocodile there. In this whole dock, only you can take this job.
Son, if you're sure, go for it. I'll wait for good news at home. Take your food. Don't push it if you can't find them. Be sure to come back before dark.

Be sure to come back before dark. Don't worry, Mom and Dad. When I bring back the Abalone, our shop will reopen tomorrow. Boss! Under that big rock ahead there are a bunch of those stone slices you wanted.
those stone slices you wanted. They're called abalone. We found a lot today. I'll get you a treat later. Hold tight, Boss! I'll dig out all the biggest ones!
Nearly a pound. The shell is intact. Ms. Dalton's order
Ms. Dalton's order is pretty much secured. Boss, over here! There are two fat ones!
There are two fat ones! I didn't touch them, afraid they might shrink back in. You're using your brain this time. You guard the back. I'll pry them.
These two are over a pound each. They alone can sell for 700 bucks. I found them! I'll credit you for it! I'll give you two extra fish when we get back.
Boss, come quick! There's a whole bunch of fat ones here!
At least 30 pounds.
At least 30 pounds. This bag alone is worth a lot. It's my secret spot! Of course it has the best stuff. We still have time. Let's find a few more over a pound. Then today's order is locked in.
Then today's order is locked in. Over 30 pounds of big abalone. Not a single one damaged. Today was totally worth the trip. Let's leave the catch here for now.
Let's leave the catch here for now. The current won't reach this pillar. And the rope won't come loose. Don't worry, Boss. I'll keep watch right here. Even the waves won't take a single one!
Something's snagged underneath.
Boss! It's that old guy with the big shell! He's getting dragged down by that broken trap! The abalone is secure.
The abalone is secure. Finn, come down with me. You bite onto the trap's rope, and I'll cut the net off him. Don't worry, Boss. Once I bite down, I won't let go!
Hurry up, boss! This stupid cage is heavy as hell. Boss!
Boss! I haven't let go! Keep going!
You're pretty quick, old buddy. We just saved you, and now you've saved me.
Don't forget me! If I hadn't held the rope, you guys would've fallen! I know you helped a lot. I'll get you extra fish later.
Have a bite. Your wound will heal in a few days. Rescue and feeding complete.

Rescue and feeding complete. Bondable sea beast detected: Old Shelly. Knows tides and hidden reefs, rivers and deep-water resources. Can communicate once bonded, and boosts diving perception and defense capabilities.
and defense capabilities. Bond with beast? I found another bondable sea beast. Bond. Old Shelly bonded successfully.
Old Shelly bonded successfully. Bonded Keeper gains Ocean Adaptation Physique. Can enter normal coastal waters to breathe, see, and move normally. Young man. Steady hands. A bit later, and my leg
and my leg would be gone. If I didn't hold that cage, you wouldn't even have a chance to talk. Weren't you the one tumbling around earlier?
tumbling around earlier? I was just finding a better angle! Haha, okay. You're the real hero. You heard the boss. I'll let it slide.
I can really breathe underwater. Deep areas I couldn't reach before,
Deep areas I couldn't reach before, I can dive down there now. The catch is fine. Tonight's order is secured.
order is secured. These abalones aren't that big. There's Backflow Reef up ahead. The water is calmer there, and the abalones are plumper. The ones I found are plump too!
The ones I found are plump too! I didn't say they weren't. The ones ahead are just bigger. Let's go take a look. We already have over 30 pounds.
We already have over 30 pounds. If we find some big ones over a pound, we'll make a killing today! So many giant abalones over a pound! For Ms. Dalton's order,
For Ms. Dalton's order, not only can we deliver, we'll give her the best catch in Luna Cove! Clean shells. Great size, too. These abalones are even better
These abalones are even better than the ones before. Boss! Two more fat ones on the left. Guard them if you spot them. Don't let the fish get near them.
Don't let the fish get near them. This water will only stay calm for a bit. Once the high tide rolls in,
Once the high tide rolls in, these reef cracks will be hard to pass. We have enough time. Only grab the biggest ones. We leave once the second net is full.
No need to hold my breath. And I can see the stuff in the crevices crystal clear.
About a pound and a half. This is the biggest one today.
You're awesome, Boss! Getting it out of that tight spot! Now who was it that said they'd smash the rocks open with their head? I was just giving you a backup plan, Boss.
a backup plan, Boss. Cut the crap. We've got about 50 pounds total. Ms. Dalton's order
Ms. Dalton's order is safely in the bag! The rising tide is here. Follow me through the backflow channel.
The smallest is seven or eight ounces. There's over a dozen over a pound. I'll take the whole batch.
I'll take the whole batch. Total weight 52.8 pounds. Not a single one is damaged.
The large ones are 360 a pound. Medium ones 280. That's 15,600 total. Doug. Morgan made 15,000 on this trip.
15,000 on this trip. Our son said if he's bringing goods back, he wouldn't come home empty-handed.
These big abalones are rare, but you got them all in one day. For any future rush orders, you'll be my first call. You pay a fair price.
When I get a good catch, I'll bring it here first. Mom, get the freezer fixed tomorrow, then we'll restock the shop. Giles is waiting for us to fold,
Giles is waiting for us to fold, but we're gonna build this business right back up. I'm with you. I'll keep track of every penny.
I'll keep track of every penny. Ms. Dalton, sell me a bucket of scrap fish. I've got two big heroes today who haven't had their dinner yet.
who haven't had their dinner yet. The fish you bought is so good, Boss.
Shelly, you worked hard yesterday, too. Eat up. I may eat slowly, but I eat a lot. The boss gave this to me. Once you finish yours,
Once you finish yours, stay away from mine! Don't worry. Even with my strong jaws, I couldn't chew your wooden tub.
No need to fight. Work hard for me, and there'll be plenty of fish. Let's head out when you're done. Ms. Dalton is buying wild sea cucumbers. Let's go to Chillstone Reef today
and try our luck. It's Morgan again. That crocodile doesn't just listen to him. It swims so fast carrying a person! It has a shallow draft, so it can cross reefs and shoals.
Even with a boat, we can't go where it goes. It's just an animal. How capable can it be? Speed up and follow him! We can't go any further. It's all hidden reefs below.

It's all hidden reefs below. If the propeller hits one, we're done for! Boss, that junk boat can't catch me. Don't worry about them. The places boats can't reach hide the real good stuff. No wonder he doesn't have a boat

No wonder he doesn't have a boat but still gets a full haul every day. We can only stop outside. He rides a crocodile and goes wherever he wants. He just happened to find a few reefs no one goes to. The stuff in there
will be gone sooner or later. But he seems to go somewhere different every time. Cold water's bubbling up from the bottom. Sea cucumbers love hiding under these exposed rocks.
under these exposed rocks. This Six-Spike Sea Cucumber weighs half a pound! Wild sea cucumbers like this can easily sell fresh for 300 dollars a pound!
These guys are hiding pretty well. They almost fooled old Shelly. Boss, Finn is guarding the stash.
Boss, Finn is guarding the stash. Not a single one will get away! Over 40 pounds of sea cucumbers, and plenty of sea urchins and snails, too. This trip will make us at least 10,000 dollars!
The wind is picking up. It's time to head back.
The sea cucumbers are meaty. The urchin roe is plump too. This whole batch is restaurant premium grade. Sea cucumbers, 46 pounds.
Sea cucumbers, 46 pounds. Sea urchins, 68 pieces. Babylon shells, 27 pounds. Sea cucumbers at $260 a pound. Urchins and shells are separate. That's $14,200 in total. $15,000 yesterday.
$15,000 yesterday. And another $14,000 today. Morgan. We really made the $30,000. That's my boy! He promised to save the shop. And he actually got the money!
And he actually got the money! Hahaha! Weight, unit price, and total are all on the receipt. You can double-check.
The numbers are good. Thanks, Ms. Dalton. You found the goods yourself. No need to thank me.
Where'd you get the $30,000? How did I earn it? Everyone on the dock saw it. The money is right here. Now hand over our shop's mortgage deed.

mortgage deed. Who knows if it's enough? Count it in front of everyone. If it's short, I'll make it up. Not a bill short. Just hand over the deed and the receipt. So what if Giles took the SeaRunner? Morgan has no boat,

Morgan has no boat, but riding his croc a few times he made over $30,000! The SeaRunner has only brought back trash fish lately. Minus the gas money, it probably doesn't even match what Morgan makes in a day. One has a boat but no catch. The other rides a croc and returns full every day! Who really needs who here?
Who really needs who here? I think it's pretty clear now! Hahaha! He just got lucky and found some untouched reefs. Once he fishes them out, we'll see how cocky he is!
Knowing where the good stuff hides isn't something you can buy with a boat. You can steal the SeaRunner, but you can't steal my skills to make a living at sea.
Where's the receipt? Write clearly that the $30,000 is paid in full and the mortgage is void.

I gave you the deed back! Why do you need a receipt? When we borrowed the money, you made us sign with our fingerprints! We need proof of repayment too! Everything that needs to be written down must be included. Not a word less.

must be included. Not a word less. You've already taken the money. You don't even dare to write a receipt? Are you planning to use the old debt to extort them again? Yeah, paying off a debt is only right! Stop dragging your feet and write it!
The shop's debt is cleared. The SeaRunner and my $120,000,
The SeaRunner and my $120,000, we'll settle that later. Mr. Barrett. Are we gonna let him keep earning? Every time he comes back with valuable goods.
valuable goods. It's definitely not just the croc. First, we find out where he dives and which way he heads. You want to follow him to the reefs? Once we find the spot, the goods in the sea
the goods in the sea belong to whoever grabs them first. Genevieve. Your shop staying open for good now? It is! We'll have fresh seafood every day now. Hahaha, that's great!
Hahaha, that's great!
We just got back on our feet. Why buy me new clothes? Dad. Your old coat the cuffs are completely worn out. We saved the shop. Buying a new coat isn't a big deal.
My shoes are still fine. You dive the reefs, you should buy yourself a good pair first. I got myself wading shoes too. The money I earn is to make our lives more comfortable.
is to make our lives more comfortable. Stop being so stingy on yourselves. Alright, my son bought it, I'll wear it. I'll make meat dumplings for lunch. Maris has helped us out a lot.
Maris has helped us out a lot. You should invite her over. Mom She's still busy taking in stock. She still needs to eat. Just go and invite her.
Hey, big shell! I had my eyes on that one! Stare all you want, Shelly still bites faster.
Boss, these are all going in the water. We'll need them for our trips. You carry the cargo.
You carry the cargo. Shelly shows me the way. I dive for the goods. We all have our part to play. Leave the heaviest stuff to me! Just learn to tell a tank from a log first.
from a log first. Stop ramming into things. That time, I was just testing if it was sturdy! Two restaurants in the city want a long-term supply of live royal lobsters and wild sea cucumbers.

live royal lobsters and wild sea cucumbers. They don't need much per order, but they need stock every week. Big one-off orders bring quick cash, but a steady supply keeps the shop's income rolling in. I'll handle the buyers and the saltwater tanks.

and the saltwater tanks. You take care of the ocean side. Yesterday we only searched the edge of Chillstone Reef. Beneath Blackstone Reef, there are a few deep trenches that should hold more goods. There are a lot of crevices there. Before you go in, make sure your safety line is secure.

make sure your safety line is secure. Don't worry. When I get back, I'll treat you to meat dumplings at my place. Are your parents treating me, or are you? My parents are treating. I'm just in charge of making the dumpling money in the sea.
making the dumpling money in the sea. Heh.
Boss, something's stealing your knife!
You weren't stealing it. You wanted me to save you. Give me the knife.
So you took Boss's knife! Let go! I'll smash this cage for you! You dare hit me?
Boss, move! Eat this first. Cutting the ropes will hurt. Bear with it.
Don't move. Two left. Almost done.
Finn, pull him out. Boss, are you hurt? I just knew that eight-legged freak would be trouble.
At least you returned my stuff. Didn't save you for nothing. Rescue and feeding complete.
Rescue and feeding complete. Target accepts Bonded Keeper. Adult octopus. Excels in narrow spaces, precision touch, untying knots, and finding resources. Initiate BeastBond?
Initiate BeastBond? Bonding third Sea Beast Companion. Octopus BeastBond complete. Precision touch, untying skills, and narrow space mobility

space mobility are enhanced. Master! You can finally understand me! I banged that knife for ages! And that bighead outside even tried to ram me! You just learned to speak, and you dare call me bighead?
Your head couldn't even fit through the hole! How's that not big? Come down here if you dare! Let's see who swims faster! If you two want to argue, get off my back first.
get off my back first. Hey. Dexter, the sea cucumbers you put in the net, where did you find them? Master! There are still
There are still lots of squishy things inside. And hiding in the holes nearby are a bunch of bearded guys.
Grabbing seafood with eight arms! Dexter, your skills came in right on time! Master, come quick! Deep inside there's a really big guy! I can't pull it out by myself.
I can't pull it out by myself. Master, come quick! This big guy keeps digging deeper! I can barely hold on! Such a huge Ruby Grouper!
Such a huge Ruby Grouper! It's gotta be at least 15 pounds! And it's alive and in perfect shape! This alone could sell for thousands of dollars! Master, it's way too strong! Eight arms aren't enough!
Eight arms aren't enough! Don't force it, let go. Over by the hole, I'll catch it when it dashes out!
Boss, I'll pin it down! It's a live catch! One swipe of your claws, and the price drops by half! Go watch the net outside! I was just afraid it'd hit you, Boss.
I was just afraid it'd hit you, Boss. I wasn't craving it. You're drooling all over the cave. Master, they're all over the place! So squishy! One for each arm.
None of them can hide! A three or four-pound Grand Conch is quite rare. Dexter, those eyes of yours are put to good use! Master, I have eight arms, too!
Master, I have eight arms, too! What's the use of so many arms if I'm the one who has to carry everything back! The tide is turning. A strong current will soon enter the cave.
A strong current will soon enter the cave. That's enough for today. Let's go.
Eight legs, don't choke my neck! Swim steadier! Master's Scarlet Snapper almost fell! Stop arguing, the fish is still alive.
Stop arguing, the fish is still alive. It'll fetch a good price back at the harbor! Clear eyes, red gills. We'll offer $4,500. I bid $5,000!
I bid $5,000! The city really needs a great centerpiece fish. Your call. Sold for $5,000. Weigh the rest separately. The Ruby Grouper is $5,000. Other seafood is $13,600. That's $18,600 in total.
That's $18,600 in total. A Ruby Grouper this big? Where did you get it? You kicked me off the boat. Where I find my catch is none of your business.

is none of your business. The eyes are all cloudy. We can only take it as standard. SeaRunner was out all day, but it still can't beat Morgan's one single fish! So what if he took the boat? Morgan rides a croc with an octopus,
Morgan rides a croc with an octopus, and still earns way more! Hahaha! Got lucky once and you're smug. To chase big fish out there, you're still stuck without a boat.
you're still stuck without a boat. True, a raft can't carry much. My next step is buying my own boat. Hmph. Made a few bucks and you dare dream of being a captain?

dream of being a captain? I beat you without a boat. When I get my own boat, you'll feel even worse. Auntie, that's really enough. I can't finish if you give me more. My mom wants you to eat. Don't be so polite.
Don't be so polite. I'll help if you can't finish it. Get your own if you want it! Don't use Maris as an excuse. Morgan, this is the receipt for the $120,000 sent to Giles.

for the $120,000 sent to Giles. The transfer slips and receipts, your mom kept them all. When he took the money, he was all sweet talk. Once the boat made a profit, he turned his back on us. Mom, it's useful to keep these.

Mom, it's useful to keep these. But I won't drop my real business just to obsess over him every day. So what's your plan? Make money first. Buy a boat that's better than the SeaRunner. When I sail my boat back to the dock, I'll take those receipts, and in front of everyone,

and in front of everyone, I'll settle the score with Giles over the $120,000 and the SeaRunner once and for all. At this rate, a few more trips, and you could look at used motorboats. That's our boy. They can take the boat,
They can take the boat, but they can't take Morgan's knack for making money. Eight legs, one for each! That is cheating! I have eight arms.

I have eight arms. One fish per arm. It's totally fair. By that logic, since my mouth is huge, shouldn't I eat the whole bowl? You guys keep arguing. While you figure it out, Shelly will just eat two more.

The guy with the big shell is the biggest cheater of all! Warm water is flowing into the bay. It brought a school of fish. Master. It's pitch black underwater over there. Full of fish! We haven't bought a boat yet,

We haven't bought a boat yet, but the big school of fish is here. Finn. We'll go check it out tomorrow morning. Sure. I will definitely get there before those junk boats. Boss, hurry up! All those fish last night They'll be gone if we're late!
They'll be gone if we're late! Who knows if the fish are gone, but your breakfast is about to be. Hey, eight-legs! That's my breakfast! The master said we need a full stomach.
we need a full stomach. I'm just listening better than you. Knock it off. Find the fish, and you'll get extra portions later. The birds aren't flying high. And what they're catching

And what they're catching are just small sardines. The big fish must be near the surface. Master, the small fish below are all fleeing one way. Like something's chasing them. Southeast waters are warmer. The big schools chasing them won't stay in the open sea.

won't stay in the open sea. They'll likely follow the warm water into Reef Bay. Let's ignore the birds. We'll block the inlet first. No matter how fast they swim, they have to pass through there. The warm water enters the bay from the southeast.

The warm water enters the bay from the southeast. The big fish are driving the little ones toward the shallow reef. Silver pomfrets. About a pound each. Nice shiny scales too. This whole bay is full of valuable fresh catch.

valuable fresh catch. Master. I'll go down and herd them right into the net. Hold on. The school split into three. The largest group is hugging the reef. Rushing them will just scare them away. Finn, flank the left.
Finn, flank the left. Don't charge the school. Shelly, guard the right trench. Dexter, help me lay the net.
Master, they split up. Which side do I chase? Don't chase the front.
Don't chase the front. The real big school is still coming. Boss, there's a bunch over there too. Are we really not chasing?

Are we really not chasing? The little fish are still fleeing towards us. That means there's more behind them. Chasing the small groups now would waste the whole net. I'll listen to you, Boss. Forget the small fry. We'll wait for the big ones.
We'll wait for the big ones. This is the current. Dexter, hold the bottom of the net! Finn, press the left side! Don't let them go around!
Dexter! Hold the right sinker! Don't let the fish slip under the net! Master, they are crashing into me! I can't hold them!
Hold on for three seconds! One, Two! It's closed! They charged at me together! I was almost dragged down! You still have energy to complain.
You still have energy to complain. Guess you're doing fine. Boss! The net is full of silver fish! It's totally packed this time! Boss! This one jumped up on its own! I didn't take a single bite!
The scales are intact. Nice catch. Master! I caught so many at once! So what if you caught a lot? I was the one who held the whole net for Boss!
the whole net for Boss! Boss's net here caught way more than he did. Master is the best, of course. Comparing Master to me? That's cheating! Over 300 pounds. All prime catch, not a single scratch.

All prime catch, not a single scratch. If we keep 'em in this condition, they'll fetch at least ten grand back at the dock. That's enough. If we load any more, the raft won't hold up. Let the rest go.
The school is right inside! Take us in! Mr. Barrett, the entrance is too narrow! The hull's gonna scrape for sure!

The hull's cracked! And the fish all got away! Dammit! Morgan hauls in over ten grand, and I don't even get a single scale! Now I'm stuck paying for repairs! Slow down a bit, Finn. Silver pomfret scales are thin.

Silver pomfret scales are thin. If they get crushed or bruised, the price will drop significantly. Don't worry, Morgan. I guarantee they'll go back nice and comfortable. Master, I'm watching them. The ice and wet cloths won't go anywhere.
The ice and wet cloths won't go anywhere. You were the fastest when grabbing fish earlier, and now you're the busiest protecting them. I'm fast, so of course I can take care of everything well.
